newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BES says launches up to $1 bln EMTN programme.
newsitem.headline: BES says launches up to $1 bln EMTN programme.

text.p: Portuguese bank Banco Espirito Santo said in a statement it was launching via BES Finance a programme of Euro Medium Term Notes for up to $1 billion.
"The EMTN programme is an excellent instrument to permit financing at a more favourable cost in a variety of currencies -- in this case 20 currencies," BES said.
"The notes will be listed in Luxembourg, and the issues could be public or private," it added.
BES is the first Portuguese financial institition to establish an EMTN programme.
The issuer will be BES Finance, an offshore entity guaranteed wholly by BES.
